"HelloFresh Cash is store credit that can be used toward your future HelloFresh orders. It’s automatically applied to your next box—no extra steps needed! Most credits can be combined with other rewards and discounts, while older credits issued until 30.06.2025 might not combine. Don’t worry, we’ll always apply your eligible credit whenever it can be used. HelloFresh Cash may be issued as: - Compensation from Customer Care - Referral bonuses - Promotional rewards You can check your HelloFresh Cash balance anytime to see available funds."

Sometimes. Newer credits can be used alongside other HelloFresh discounts. Older credits might not combine with additional promotions, but we’ll always apply your eligible credit automatically when it can be used.
